name: La2(MoO4)3 monoclinic bulk alternative

source.title: Crystal structure of La (Mo O4)3, a new ordered defect Scheelite type

scope: Independent undoped monoclinic ordered-defect-scheelite reference. Yi’s 800 °C product is assigned tetragonal with an unidentified second phase; this monoclinic cell does not resolve that assignment or model Yb/Er dopant sites. Other annealing variants retain their own phase gaps. These are independent periodic reference coordinates, not a measured reconstruction of the synthesis product, surface, strain, interface, ligand shell or atomistic training target.
representation_note: Symmetry-expanded conventional reference cell. Partial and mixed sites are statistical populations, not independently occupied atoms or one ordered microstate.
